# TikTok playbook for AI influencers

**Grow an AI character on TikTok in 2026: AIGC labels, the crypto ban, watch-time and search signals, series, cadence and safe uploads.**

Grows an AI influencer or agent on TikTok within TikTok's 2026 rules — account setup, the AI-generated content (AIGC) label, TikTok's strict ban on crypto and financial promotion, watch-time and search signals, hooks and series formats, a sustainable posting cadence, Creator Rewards and LIVE eligibility, and an approval-first upload flow through @useclaudia/social (direct app or a posting service) or the claudia CLI. Use when someone wants to start or grow a TikTok account for an AI character, plan TikTok videos or a series, check whether a TikTok post about crypto, coins or money is allowed, schedule TikTok uploads, or understand why reach dropped.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Grow](../README.md) | intermediate | 40 min setup, 30–60 min per video | `@useclaudia/social`, `@useclaudia/cli`, `@useclaudia/media` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-08 |

## How it works

1. Hook, 0–2 s
2. Payoff, 2–20 s
3. Loop or close, last 1–2 s

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/tiktok-playbook.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/tiktok-playbook.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/tiktok-playbook.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/tiktok-playbook.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill tiktok-playbook`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `tiktok-playbook.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/tiktok-playbook`.
